pages.text: These creatures inhabiting the cold snowy biomes of the Overworld appear to be distant relatives of the Hoglin. You can mutate a Tusklin servant from a Pig, or use a ritual to bind a wild Tusklin to your will.

You can ride these powerful beasts. However, they are not fond of being ridden—even by their owner. Riding a Tusklin will cause it to start charging uncontrollably. Additionally, Ancient Hogshoes can be used to reduce fall damage for your Tusklin.
Some say that these Tusklins are descendants of Hoglins left behind in the Overworld after the Piglin invasions of Legend Ages.
Equipping Frost Robes or Wild Robes grants your Tusklin additional passive healing. You can heal your Tusklin with Brown Mushrooms, and use Red Mushrooms to breed them.
